allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Century Extrusions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of completion of Dispatch of Rights Issue related documents/Information'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Century Extrusions Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on September 08, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 : 8, i.e 3 Equity Shares for every 8 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 15 per share.
